We perform a manual analysis of models' predictions on NL-SCHEMAORG compositional development set. We inspect 40 predictions of 8 models, and identify three major error types.
guideline: Categorize errors into three types: Benign errors (semantically equivalent but different query), Linking errors (mismatch between utterance and query), and Structural errors (syntax errors). Also measure robustness to DB entity replacement.
